text:
erin: Quick ask — support needs temporary console access to investigate a customer incident in prod. They only need logs + exported bigquery view for ~1 hour. What's the least-privilege role we should grant and who can approve?

michael: Do we know exactly which logs/tables? can we scope to a single project or dataset?

erin: Yes — project = prod-telemetry, bigquery dataset = logs_exported, and they only need read access. Not trying to access secrets or infra config.

ana: (cc @sec-bot) Prefer JIT ephemeral grant. For GCP: give Logs Viewer on the project + BigQuery Data Viewer on the dataset. TTL 1h by default.

jordan: Will the exported logs contain PII or raw request bodies? if so we need redaction/consent.

erin: We've redacted PII at ingest but there are a handful of raw traces that might show user identifiers. The support flow only needs stack traces + timestamps, not user emails.

michael: In that case create a custom role that limits to these permissions:
```
- logging.logEntries.list
- logging.logs.list
- bigquery.tables.get
- bigquery.tables.getData
```
and bind it at project/dataset scope. Avoid owner/editor roles.

ana: Quick sample IAM grant (GCP):
```
# grant custom role binding
gcloud projects add-iam-policy-binding prod-telemetry \
  --member="user:support@example.com" \
  --role="roles/logging.viewer" \
  --condition="expression=request.time < timestamp(\"2023-01-01T00:00:00Z\")"  # example condition
```
But we'll use our JIT system instead of long-lived bindings.

sec-bot: Policy reminder: ephemeral access must be <= 4h and require explicit approver from the owning team. See https://redwood.internal/policies/ephemeral-access.

jordan: I can approve for this case. I confirm support user is on the ticket and will follow privacy checklist.

erin: Thanks — action list: ana to create custom role + JIT config; michael to attach dataset-level BQ view; jordan to approve request when created.

ana: Will open PR to infra-config with role definition and a JIT request template. TTL set to 1h, scopes: logging viewer (project), bigquery.dataViewer (dataset).

michael: One more ask — please log the granting event to audit-log channel and include ticket #INC-12345.

erin: Will do. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:

jordan: Approved when PR posts. :white_check_mark:
